calibration.csv.purpose: Trial-level Ridge calibration intercept and slope with fixed-OOF intervals.

calibration_bands.csv.purpose: Calibration line and pointwise fixed-OOF bootstrap bands; Figure 5.

data_audit.csv.purpose: Aggregate source counts, repeat-run distinctions, response coherence and age distribution.

leave_level_grouped_stress.csv.purpose: Condition extrapolation stress tests combined with held-out identifiers.

legacy_validation_comparison.csv.purpose: Matched legacy aggregate target: row-wise versus identifier-grouped validation; Figure 2.

participant_mean_metrics.csv.purpose: Ridge performance after separately averaging observed and OOF-predicted scores within identifier.

primary_model_performance.csv.purpose: Five models in each of four datasets, with fixed-OOF R-squared intervals; Figure 3.

ridge_feature_sets.csv.purpose: Eight fixed Ridge feature sets per dataset.

ridge_feature_sets_with_intervals.csv.purpose: The same feature sets with fixed-OOF R-squared intervals; Figure 6.

ridge_group_permutation.csv.purpose: Identifier-level demographic-block and frame-rate permutation diagnostics.

ridge_permutation_importance.csv.purpose: Trial-row permutation diagnostics, by feature, held-out fold and independent repeat; Figure 7.

ridge_split_sensitivity.csv.purpose: Ridge refitted under five alternative identifier-grouped fold assignments.

source_verification.csv.purpose: Exact SHA-256 fingerprints of the four required source workbooks.
